Join the official group for information and updates:  https://chat.whatsapp.com/KtW8LRvLU8cIiUavLT00oN

CodeEncoders India 2026 is an exciting 36-hour national online hackathon where innovators build, collaborate and compete.
Participants can earn exciting prizes, awards and participation benefits—not only by winning, but also by completing the hackathon.

About:

  • Top three teams: Paid internship opportunities
  • Top three teams Prize Pool: 30,000 Rs
  • Every participant: One complimentary .xyz domain / .cv domain
  • Every participant: Certificate - QR Verifiable Certificate
  • Every participant: $100 in Inkloom AI credits, 500$ Adaption AI credits
  • Rewards: 100+ recipients across the hackathon
  • Dates: 8th December 10:00 AM - 9th December 10:00 PM 2026
  • Duration: 36 hrs
  • Mode: Completely online
  • Team size: 1–6 members
  • Registration fee: free
  • Tracks: Agentic AI, Full-Stack Product Engineering.

Join the official WhatsApp group for participation details, announcements and important hackathon updates.

A participant must complete the hackathon and make a valid final submission to receive a verifiable digital certificate. Registration alone will not qualify a participant for a certificate.

Incubation, PPOs and partner benefits are subject to eligibility requirements, availability and the respective partner’s selection process.
